limitations: This is an externally authored synthetic reference, not observed patient data.
No decline labels, predictive validation, diagnostic accuracy or population prevalence are inferred from this archive.
Daily autocorrelation, observation scheduling, symptoms, medication-taking and fall events in Samarth Care are explicitly authored simulation assumptions.
Unavailable modalities retain disclosed illustrative assumptions. Medication orders do not establish whether a person took a dose.
